tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len bzhugs so// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la sems can srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ pad ma zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru dang / g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ gru mo'i khug na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lte bar chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs gcig gi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hwaṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /badzra waraṇṇa nī ye/ rdo rje rigs ldan ma/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus tha mal pa bsregs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsanḍi ka'i ngo bo/ snying kha'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs gi lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal las khang / bcud kyi sems can rnal 'byor mar gyur/ yang waṃ yig las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba pheṃ badzra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarb+ba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ rnal 'byor dag pa chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'o/ rang gi gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar po'i gnas su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung / yang lte bar chos 'byung zla ba waṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i gra bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad/

sngags phreng yid kyis klog pa'i tshul byed cing rlung bzung / rang gi snying khar chos 'byung sngags phreng waṃ yig las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'od dmar po'i rnam par byung ste rang la thim par bsam la/ oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzlas so/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros gzugs med khams lus kyi stod la thim/ gzugs khams bar la thim/ 'dod khams smad la thim/ rang gi lus kyi stod smad snying kha'i thad du thim/ de yang snying kha'i chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de sngags phreng la thim/ de baṃ yig la thim/ de khog pa la thim/ de mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar stong pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag skad cig gis rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang / sngar bzhin go cha dgod sumbha ni'i sngags kyis phyogs mtshams bsrung / hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur dag oṃ gsum ma brjod/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad sngags kyi rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam rtog thams cad ye shes kyi ngo bor bkod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang / 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs dang / rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs brjod/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag sogs bya'o/ /tshul 'di dang po'i las can 'gas/ /nyams su blang phyir sa skya pa/ /ā nanda yis myur bar bris/ /dge bas mkha' spyod 'grub par shog/ //shu bhaṃ/ ye waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/
